THE GRANT-MAKING DUE DILIGENCE & MONITORING POLICY OUTLINES THE DUE DILIGENCE AND MONITORING PROCEDURES FOR GRANT-MAKING BY THE PHILANTHROPIC SERVICES TEAM AT FOUNDERS PLEDGE. THE DOCUMENT CATEGORIZES GRANTS INTO LOW-RISK, HIGH-RISK, HIFO (HIGH IMPACT FUND OPPORTUNITIES), AND EXPENDITURE RESPONSIBILITY (ER), EACH WITH CORRESPONDING DUE DILIGENCE AND MONITORING REQUIREMENTS. KEY ASPECTS OF THE POLICY INCLUDE: PRIMARY AND SECONDARY RISKS IN GRANT MAKING, DUE DILIGENCE CHECKLISTS, GRANT AGREEMENTS, MONITORING APPROACHES FOR HIGH-RISK AND ER GRANTS, INTERNAL GRANT AND HIGH-RISK OR NOVEL GRANT APPROVAL PROCESSES, SAFEGUARDING ADDITIONAL DUE DILIGENCE, UPDATING DUE DILIGENCE REPORTS, AND POST-GRANT MONITORING.
EXPENDITURES ARE ACCOUNTED FOR ON THE ACCRUAL BASIS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ONLY MEMBER OF THE CORPORATION SHALL BE FOUNDERS FORUM FOR GOOD LTD, A NOT-FOR-PROFIT COMPANY WITH LIABILITY LIMITED BY GUARANTEE ORGANIZED UNDER THE LAWS OF ENGLAND AND WALES, EXCEPT AS FOUNDERS FORUM FOR GOOD LTD MAY IN ITS SOLE DISCRETION PROVIDE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE DIRECTORS SHALL BE ELECTED AT EACH ANNUAL MEETING OF MEMBERS BY THE VOTE OF A MAJORITY OF THE PERSONS THEN CONSTITUTING THE MEMBERS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE BYLAWS MAY BE AMENDED, ALTERED OR REPEALED BY RESOLUTION ADOPTED BY THE AFFIRMATIVE VOTE OF DIRECTORS CONSTITUTING A MAJORITY OF THE TOTAL NUMBER OF DIRECTORS AUTHORIZED UNDER THE BYLAWS AT THE TIME OF SUCH VOTE, OR BY ACTION OF THE MEMBERS OF THE CORPORATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 WAS PROVIDED TO THE ORGANIZATION'S GOVERNING BODY FOR REVIEW BEFORE IT WAS FILED WITH THE IRS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL TRUSTEES, COMPANY DIRECTORS, AND ALL STAFF MUST DECLARE THEIR CONFLICTS OF INTERESTS, AND ANY GIFTS OR HOSPITALITY OFFERED AND RECEIVED IN CONNECTION WITH THEIR ROLE AT FOUNDERS PLEDGE. THE DECLARATION OF INTERESTS MUST BE UPDATED AT LEAST ANNUALLY, AND WHEN ANY MATERIAL CHANGES OCCUR. IF AN INDIVIDUAL BELIEVES TO HAVE A REAL OR PERCEIVED CONFLICT OF INTEREST, THEY SHOULD DECLARE THE INTEREST AT THE EARLIEST OPPORTUNITY AND WITHDRAW FROM DISCUSSIONS AND DECISIONS RELATING TO THE CONFLICT.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SALARIES AND OTHER COMPENSATION OF ALL OFFICERS AND AGENTS OF THE CORPORATION (ACTING IN SUCH CAPACITIES) SHALL BE DECIDED BY THE BOARD OR A COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD. THE BOARD OR SUCH COMMITTEE SHALL SET REASONABLE COMPENSATION THAT IS NOT EXCESSIVE, AFTER COMPARING THE COMPENSATION PAID TO OTHER, COMPARABLE POSITIONS AT OTHER ORGANIZATIONS. THE BOARD OR SUCH COMMITTEE MAY DELEGATE TO THE PRESIDENT AND/OR OTHER SENIOR OFFICERS OF THE CORPORATION ON SUCH TERMS AS IT SHALL SEE FIT THE POWER TO SET THE SALARIES AND OTHER COMPENSATION OF SUBORDINATE OFFICERS AND AGENTS OF THE CORPORATION. COMPENSATION DECISIONS MADE BY THE BOARD OR A COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD REQUIRE THE AFFIRMATIVE VOTE OF A MAJORITY OF THE DISINTERESTED DIRECTORS THEN MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OR SUCH COMMITTEE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC UPON REQUEST.
